name: Fuel Pump
text: Stands on a Carrier Tank. Use it to take the hose, then use a vehicle or tank trailer to pump 50 L per use. The hose lets go if you walk 10 m away. Age V.

name: Trailer Hitch
text: Use on a trailer to hook it to yourself or unhook it; use a vehicle with a tow bar to pass the trailer to it. Age V.

name: Repair Hammer
text: Each blow gives a damaged vehicle or trailer 5 health back. Age V.

name: Tank Trailer
text: Two-wheel fuel bowser with a 2,000 L tank. Towed with a hitch, filled by a pump, emptied into cans and vehicles. It takes crash damage and snaps free if the tow bar gets too far. Age V.
